ex.en: The prefix multi means "more than one."
ex.zh: 字首 multi 的意思是「不只一個」。

ex.en: Words that start with multi, like multimedia, involve many parts.
ex.zh: 以 multi 開頭的字，例如 multimedia（多媒體），都含有「多個」的意思。

ex.en: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
ex.zh: 跨國企業的表現勝過只在單一國家經營的傳統企業。

ex.en: She works for a multinational company in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她在台北的一家跨國公司上班。

ex.en: Many multinationals have offices in Singapore.
ex.zh: 許多跨國公司在新加坡設有辦公室。

ex.en: The local shop cannot compete with the multinationals.
ex.zh: 這家在地小店無法和跨國公司競爭。

ex.en: Four multiplied by two is eight.
ex.zh: 四乘以二等於八。

ex.en: Six multiplied by three is eighteen.
ex.zh: 六乘以三等於十八。

ex.en: Our problems multiplied after the merger.
ex.zh: 合併後我們的問題倍增。

ex.en: The number of online shoppers has multiplied.
ex.zh: 網購人數大幅增加。

ex.en: The municipal government is building a new park.
ex.zh: 市政府正在興建一座新公園。

ex.en: She works at the municipal library.
ex.zh: 她在市立圖書館工作。

ex.en: Tourism has a multiplier effect on the local economy.
ex.zh: 觀光業對當地經濟有乘數效應。

ex.en: In 4 x 5, the multiplier is 5.
ex.zh: 在 4 x 5 中，乘數是 5。

ex.en: We hope to find a mutually beneficial solution.
ex.zh: 我們希望找到雙贏的解決方案。

ex.en: Let's find a mutually convenient time to meet.
ex.zh: 我們找個雙方都方便的時間見面吧。

ex.en: I don't have much time.
ex.zh: 我沒有太多時間。

ex.en: We didn't have much rain this year.
ex.zh: 今年雨下得不多。

ex.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
ex.zh: 你菸抽太多了，應該少抽一點。

ex.en: Are you aware of how much she loves you?
ex.zh: 你知道她有多愛你嗎？

ex.en: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
ex.zh: 估算一下你花了多少錢買書。

ex.en: How much is this jacket?
ex.zh: 這件外套多少錢？

ex.en: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
ex.zh: 你必須在五點前到車站。

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你必須小心，別惹他生氣。

ex.en: You must be tired after such a long trip.
ex.zh: 這麼長的旅程之後，你一定很累了。

ex.en: She must be at home now.
ex.zh: 她現在一定在家。

ex.en: A good pair of shoes is a must for hiking.
ex.zh: 爬山一定要有一雙好鞋。

ex.en: This museum is a must for visitors.
ex.zh: 這間博物館是遊客必訪之地。

ex.en: Few things give us as much pleasure as music.
ex.zh: 很少有東西能像音樂一樣帶給我們這麼多快樂。

ex.en: When I study, I listen to music with earphones.
ex.zh: 我讀書的時候會戴耳機聽音樂。

ex.en: He went to Italy in order to study music.
ex.zh: 他為了學音樂去了義大利。

ex.en: The murder happened between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.
ex.zh: 這起兇殺案發生在凌晨三點到五點之間。

ex.en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
ex.zh: 法院判他謀殺罪不成立。

ex.en: There's a possibility that the man was murdered.
ex.zh: 那個男人有可能是被謀殺的。

ex.en: My grandfather was murdered during the Second World War.
ex.zh: 我外公在第二次世界大戰期間遇害。

ex.en: To be honest, he doesn't have any musical talent.
ex.zh: 老實說，他一點音樂天分都沒有。

ex.en: Do you play a musical instrument?
ex.zh: 你會演奏樂器嗎？

ex.en: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
ex.zh: 我最喜歡的樂器是電吉他。

ex.en: We saw a musical on Broadway last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚在百老匯看了一齣音樂劇。

ex.en: The musical was so popular that tickets sold out quickly.
ex.zh: 這齣音樂劇很受歡迎，票很快就賣光了。

ex.en: Completing this project would require the cooperation of multiple parties.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要多方合作才能完成。

ex.en: Tom has multiple talents.
ex.zh: 湯姆多才多藝。

ex.en: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
ex.zh: 同一個句子裡不要放多個替代字詞。

ex.en: Remember, exercise helps strengthen your muscles and bones.
ex.zh: 記住，運動有助於強化肌肉和骨骼。

ex.en: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游完泳後要伸展肌肉。

ex.en: I pulled a muscle in my leg while running.
ex.zh: 我跑步時拉傷了腿部肌肉。

ex.en: He was destined to become a great musician.
ex.zh: 他注定要成為偉大的音樂家。

ex.en: He has three sons, who became musicians.
ex.zh: 他有三個兒子，後來都成了音樂家。

ex.en: Do you know when the musician will come here?
ex.zh: 你知道那位音樂家什麼時候會來這裡嗎？

ex.en: The virus has developed a new mutation.
ex.zh: 這種病毒出現了新的突變。

ex.en: Scientists found a genetic mutation linked to the disease.
ex.zh: 科學家發現了一種和這種疾病有關的基因突變。

muddy.zh: 泥濘的、沾滿泥的；混濁的

ex.en: The passing car splashed muddy water on me.
ex.zh: 車子經過時把泥水濺到我身上。

ex.en: Take off your muddy shoes before you come in.
ex.zh: 進來前先脫掉你沾滿泥巴的鞋。

ex.en: Too many details will muddy your message.
ex.zh: 細節太多會讓你的訊息不清楚。

ex.en: The new data only muddied the picture.
ex.zh: 新數據反而讓情況更加混亂。

ex.en: Toronto is a very multicultural city.
ex.zh: 多倫多是一座非常多元文化的城市。

ex.en: Our school has a multicultural student body.
ex.zh: 我們學校的學生來自多元文化背景。

multilateral.zh: 多邊的；多國共同參與的

ex.en: The nations signed a multilateral trade agreement.
ex.zh: 各國簽署了一項多邊貿易協定。

ex.en: A multilateral meeting will begin on Monday.
ex.zh: 多邊會議將於星期一開始。

ex.en: The course uses multimedia to explain each process.
ex.zh: 這門課程運用多媒體說明各項流程。

ex.en: Our website supports multimedia files.
ex.zh: 我們的網站支援多媒體檔案。

ex.en: I hardly ever go to museums.
ex.zh: 我幾乎不去博物館。

ex.en: After ten minutes' walk we came to the museum.
ex.zh: 我們走了十分鐘就到了博物館。

ex.en: Please put out your cigarettes before entering the museum.
ex.zh: 進入博物館前請先把菸熄掉。

ex.en: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
ex.zh: 真正的友誼建立在彼此信任的基礎上。

ex.en: Mutual understanding promotes peace.
ex.zh: 相互理解能促進和平。

ex.en: They have mutual respect.
ex.zh: 他們互相尊重。

ex.en: They want to talk to you about areas of mutual interest.
ex.zh: 他們想和你談談彼此都感興趣的領域。

ex.en: We met through a mutual friend.
ex.zh: 我們是透過共同的朋友認識的。
